strongest_real_composition_rival.competence_assumption: The rival is permitted to label its domain, state preconditions, individual properties, witnesses, counterexamples, and OOA outcomes explicitly.

C2.load_bearing_test: Changes a negative claim to OOA when a query lies outside a declared representation domain.
C2.reason: Domain preconditions plus provenance make the identical output available to the rival; the conjunction is good practice, not a non-compositional invariant.
C2.minimal_counterexample: An out-of-domain reachability query is negative under an unguarded routine and OOA under a guarded routine; a conventional checker with the same precondition has the same correction.

C3.load_bearing_test: Separates observation aliasing, action exclusion, and OOA rather than returning a single bit.
C3.reason: A labelled property suite with provenance and counterexamples gives the same partition; no new measurable or certificate relation remains after the rival is granted those ordinary capabilities.
C3.minimal_counterexample: Two procedures share aggregate success but differ on one OOA-labelled input; ordinary per-property reporting isolates the same discrepancy.

C4.load_bearing_test: Changes a future external test design by requiring paired observation/action/OOA probes.
C4.reason: These are coverage dimensions already expressible as conventional benchmark strata and model-checking properties. Tier C lacks independently custodied data/code, so no external test-design change is earned.
C4.minimal_counterexample: Two systems agree on aggregate tasks but one fails a surface-fixed selector; adding that labelled selector to a standard suite distinguishes them without EWRA-specific machinery.

C5.load_bearing_test: Supports independent reuse of exact positive, negative, and OOA certificates.
C5.reason: The bank is a valuable bounded fixture but does not independently establish a phenomenon or a method output beyond its cube-specific authority.
C5.minimal_counterexample: A second exact finite-state corpus using the same schema can reproduce the audit categories; the P34 bank alone supplies no cross-world method invariant.
